subject: E-Commerce
title: Super Apps: Everything in One
description: A 60-second lesson on Super Apps: Everything in One.

hook.text: Grab in Southeast Asia is Uber + DoorDash + PayPal + Amazon in one app. Super apps are the next marketplace frontier.

buildup.text: Super apps bundle ride-hailing, food delivery, payments, and shopping into a single platform. One app does everything.

discovery.text: WeChat, Gojek, and Grab each have 100M+ users who do daily activities entirely within one app ecosystem.

twist.text: Western attempts at super apps have failed. Snap, Uber, and PayPal all tried and retreated. Culture resists bundling.

climax.text: Super apps work where mobile-first populations leapfrogged PCs. The West's desktop habits resist the format.

punchline.text: Super Apps: the goal is not certainty, but sharper thinking.

quiz.question: Why have super apps failed in Western markets?
options: Western desktop habits and app culture resist the bundled everything-in-one format
